description: This file contains unit tests for the QueryThingsPerRequestActor class within the Eclipse Ditto project. It uses Akka testkit and JUnit to verify the actor's behavior in handling SearchResult responses, retrieving thing details, including specific fields, and handling out-of-sync scenarios.

classes.name: QueryThingsPerRequestActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the behavior of the QueryThingsPerRequestActor actor, including handling empty results, full results, specific field selections, and out-of-sync scenarios.

methods.name: startActorSystem
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem and probe actors, and sets up common headers before each test.

methods.name: shutdownActorSystem
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test to clean up resources.

methods.name: sendNoRetrieveThingsOnEmptySearchResult
methods.description: Tests that an empty SearchResult response results in the actor forwarding the response unchanged.

methods.name: reconstructsQueryThingsResponseByAskingRetrieveThings
methods.description: Verifies that the actor requests retrieval of thing details when SearchResult contains item IDs, and correctly responds back.

methods.name: thingIdIsIncludedWhenOnlyThingIdIsSelected
methods.description: Ensures that when only the 'thingId' field is selected, the retrieved data maintains the 'thingId' for correct processing.

methods.name: alwaysIncludeThingIdsInInternalRoundTripOnly
methods.description: Checks that 'thingId' is always included during internal actor trips, even if the final response omits it.

methods.name: reportOutOfSyncThings
methods.description: Simulates scenarios where some things are out of sync and verifies that the actor publishes an out-of-sync event and filters the results accordingly.

methods.name: createQueryThingsPerRequestActor
methods.description: Helper method to instantiate the actor with probes for testing.

methods.name: forIdItems
methods.description: Creates a SearchResult containing specific ThingIds.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Converts given ThingIds to a JsonArray.

methods.name: asArrayWithExtra
methods.description: Converts ThingIds to a JsonArray, including additional JsonObject data.

methods.name: idItem
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject with 'thingId' field set to the given ThingId.
